amendment_reason: A 636-second all-or-nothing free metadata quote completed its remote work but was discarded because an unrelated HYP-TRENDSTACK-EURUSD-H1-002 row was appended during the quote. The generic registry remains valid and the bound EVENT-CLOB row is byte-identical. Prevent unrelated append-only activity from invalidating a no-cost, no-outcome quote while preserving exact global-registry gating before every paid boundary.
contract_change: At free-quote start, require the exact V6 global registry SHA, exact bound hypothesis row, frozen packets, clock, preregistration, and tool bindings.

At free-quote completion, permit append-only global registry drift only when the bound EVENT-CLOB row and every frozen binding remain exact. Record start and end registry SHA values in the quoted plan and receipt; never hide drift.
Before download authority and again after the live re-quote but before the first timeseries.get_range call, require the exact V6 global registry SHA. Any drift there must stop before paid access.
No partial quote checkpoint is authorized; final quote coverage remains exactly 630 of 630 and all paid/time-series/batch counters remain zero.
red_first_acceptance_tests: Free quote succeeds when only the global registry SHA changes after remote metadata completion but the bound row and frozen bindings remain exact, and it records both registry SHAs.
Free quote fails if the bound hypothesis row changes at completion.
Download fails before timeseries.get_range when the global registry changes during its live re-quote.
All prior 21 hardening tests remain green and the offline plan is regenerated with the final tool SHA and deterministic plan ID.
prohibitions: Do not call any remote endpoint while implementing or testing V6.
Do not make any paid, batch, or time-series request.
Do not change strategy logic, preregistration, event clock, registry rows, MQL5, MT5, docs, or unrelated files.
